context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 上方/封印/軌跡/骨格/懐疑/名門/先入観/取り除く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、明治期、上方の経済発展、丁寧に、追っていますね、研究の深さ、感心しました、本当に。
lines.en: Sakura — your paper traces the economic development of the Meiji Kamigata region so carefully. I was genuinely impressed by the depth of your research.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Unhurried pace. Leans forward slightly, eyes steady on the student. Each phrase deliberate, letting the compliment land without rushing past it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦中、封印された文学作品、戦後の社会に、与えた影響、論じました、貴重な視点でした、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I discussed how wartime literary works that were sealed away influenced post-war society. It was a really valuable perspective.
lines.style: Modest but grounded. Speaks at a conversational pace, not defensive. A small pause after the opening — she's quietly proud but doesn't perform it. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代日本の軌跡、世界史の中で、よく、論じていますね、視野の広さ、評価できますよ、桜さん、本当に。
lines.en: You argue modern Japan's trajectory really well within the context of world history. I can appreciate how broad your perspective is, Sakura.
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Slower, more deliberate than casual speech. She's thinking aloud, not lecturing. A slight smile underneath — genuine recognition of the student's growth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。社会の骨格、戦前と戦後で、どう、変わったか、丁寧に、論じました、論文の柱でした、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I examined how the backbone of society changed between the pre-war and post-war periods. It was really the central pillar of my argument.
lines.style: Focused, with underlying confidence. She's not seeking approval — stating what she knows to be true. Steady tone, no filler. A small note of satisfaction at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史の通説、懐疑的に、扱う視点、これからも、続けて欲しいですね、桜さん、研究者の道、進んで欲しい。
lines.en: I'd like you to keep approaching historical orthodoxy with that skeptical eye going forward. I hope you'll continue down the path of a researcher, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm encouragement with real weight behind it. Speaks slightly slower, like she's handing her something. Not a teacher's script — genuine investment in the student's future.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。名門の家柄、社会の階級構造に、与えた影響、扱いました、現代にも、繋がるテーマでした、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I dealt with how prestigious family lineages shaped social class structures — a theme that connects to the modern world in important ways.
lines.style: Deliberate and grounded. She's building an argument, not just answering. Slight rise in engagement toward the end, like she's realizing how the pieces fit together.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先入観を、排除した、新しい歴史記述、本当に、価値ある研究、ですね、これから、楽しみにしております。
lines.en: Writing history without preconceptions, opening up new ways of understanding — that's genuinely valuable work, Sakura. I'm looking forward to what comes next for you.
lines.style: Slower, more resonant. Each phrase lingers. Not effusive — genuine and spare. A note of real investment at the end, like she's speaking to someone she believes in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。記録から、神話的要素を、取り除く分析、本当に、苦労しました、でも、達成感、ありました、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Removing the mythic layers from the historical record was really difficult. But I felt a real sense of accomplishment once I got there.
lines.style: Honest vulnerability underneath the composure. Acknowledges the struggle without dramatizing it. A small lift at the end — earned satisfaction, not performed.
